[[File:Youngling.jpg|thumb|right|A member of the Younglings.]]

The '''Younglings''' are a military force born of the [[White Tower Schism]]. They were loyal to [[Elaida's White Tower]] and viewed [[Elaida]] as the rightful [[Amyrlin Seat]].

== Background ==

Under the command of the [[Gawyn Trakand]], sister of the missing [[Accepted]] [[Elayne Trakand]] and prince of [[Andor]] where [[Elaida]] had until recently been advisor to his mother [[Queen Morgase]], a number of [[Warder]] trainees fought to prevent the rescue of the deposed and stilled [[Amyrlin]] [[Siuan Sanche]]. They killed many of their Warder teachers, most notably [[Hammar]]. Those who fought that day were awarded a [[Tower]] emblem. Due to their youth, they adopted the name Younglings.

The Younglings were roughly the size of a [[company]].{{ref/book|13|23}}

== Activities ==

=== Embassy to the Dragon Reborn ===

The Younglings were later used by [[Elaida]] as an "honor guard" for the embassy sent to the [[Dragon Reborn]] at [[Cairhien]].

[[Galina Casban]], the leader of the embassy after the abduction of [[Rand al'Thor]], had arranged to meet some [[Shaido]] en route back to the [[Tower]].{{ref/book|6|53}} On [[Elaida]]'s orders, she attempted to arrange for Gawyn{{ref/book|7|32}} and most of the Younglings to be killed by the Shaido.{{ref/book|6|53}}{{ref/book|6|55}}

The Younglings played a significant role in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]. Their early warning allowed the embassy to establish a defensible position around the wells. The Younglings managed a breakout through the enveloping Shaido shortly after Rand al'Thor freed himself.{{ref/book|6|55}} En route to [[Tar Valon]], they gathered [[Covarla]] and eleven of the surviving [[Aes Sedai]].{{ref/book|7|p}}{{ref/book|7|32}} On their return to Tar Valon, the [[Tower Guard]] refused entry to the Younglings.{{ref/book|7|32}}

=== Siege of Tar Valon ===

During the [[Siege of Tar Valon]], the Younglings were based out of the tiny village of [[Dorlan]], from which they launched raids on detachments of the [[rebel Aes Sedai]] army.

Isolated in Dorlan and cut off from [[Tar Valon]] by the besieging rebel forces, the Younglings played no part in the [[Battle of Tar Valon]], except for the defector Gawyn Trakand, who sought out and "rescued" Egwene al'Vere from loyalist captivity at the conclusion of the battle.

=== Reunification and dissolution ===

After the Tower was reunited and [[Egwene al'Vere]] was raised [[Amyrlin Seat]] of the reintegrated Tower, some of the Younglings informed Gawyn that they no longer wished to become Warders.{{ref/book|13|22}} Gawyn petitioned [[Jimar Chubain]], the Captain of the Tower Guard, to keep the Younglings who no longer wished to become Warders together as distinct unit within the Tower Guard,{{ref/book|13|23}} which Chubain granted.{{ref/book|13|37}} Chubain almost certainly formed them into a new incarnation of the [[Tenth Tower Company]], which had been nearly wiped out during the [[Battle of Tar Valon]].{{ref/book|13|23}}{{ref/book|13|37}}
